title: 第162章 三色天雷击玄纹天骄之战震狐歌第161章 水到渠成金丹成传功授法入核心
content_zh:
秦天冷哼一声，双目死死锁定狐歌，语气冰冷中带着一丝愤怒。
“不可能！”
狐歌是什么人，别人敬他一丈，他便会还一丈，反之亦然。
他刚入核心，便遭到秦天如此逼问，饶是以狐歌的好脾气也忍不了。
狐歌双眸微眯，嘴角微扬，轻飘飘的说道：“爱信不信！”
秦天瞬间化为一道紫色的闪电，狐歌还没来得及反应就倒飞了出去。
狐歌咳嗽站起，嘴角露出一丝鲜红。
“雷灵根！”
紫电虚影缓缓凝聚，秦天的身形再度显现了出来。
“你是不是其他四洲派来的奸细！”
“本就是金丹，隐藏修为，今日才假装突破，来刺探我等？”
狐歌不想解释，他长这么大还没被如此羞辱过，此辱他定要现在还回来！
狐歌运转《苟》，身形迅速变化，化为一背部漆黑纹有金黄玄纹的蜣螂。
灰色领域自六足之下迅速向四周蔓延，笼罩方圆三百米。
这是他维持领域最大功效所能延伸的最远距离，突破金丹前他仅仅能笼罩十米，如今获得了三十倍的加成！
“红尘炼心！”
丝丝红色污秽之气自领域之内散发而出，缓缓缠向秦天。
秦天冷哼一声，念道：“雕虫小技！”
下一刻秦天瞬间化为一道光影，躲过了所有的红色秽炁，直直的冲向狐歌，没等狐歌有所反应便再度倒飞出去。
但这次他有玄纹护体，虽然不是背部应敌，但防御力依旧强横，并未受伤。

狐歌传言道：“速度挺快，可惜攻击力不足！”
面对狐歌的嘲讽，秦天双目微凝，双手迅速结印。
下一刻只见空中乌云密布，隐隐有雷声轰鸣。
“攻击力不足？”
“头一次听到这种评价！”
“让你见识见识我的厉害！”
下一刻一道红色天雷从空中落下，瞬间便劈到狐歌身体之上。
前两次吃了暗亏，狐歌早已将自己蜷缩在甲壳之中。
天雷威力虽大，将地面都劈出一个大坑，但对茅不易无效，他那金色玄纹仿佛天生克制天雷一般。
任何威力的天雷都无法伤其分毫。
“行不行啊！”狐歌再度嘲讽。
秦天双目一凝，脸上浮现一丝愤怒。
“这是你自找的，劈死你也是你活该！”
秦天指尖顶天，骤然落下，一道紫色天雷应声劈在狐歌身体之上。
那金色玄纹面对天雷，仿佛是感觉到挑衅一般，自动从甲壳之上脱落，形成一金色光幕将狐歌保护在其中。
秦天大吃一惊，这紫色天雷虽不是他最强的攻击，但足以磨灭一般的金丹后期强者。
这狐歌仅仅是金丹前期的气息，他是如何扛下来的！
看着那奇妙的金色玄纹构成的保护罩，秦天不再留手。
下一刻一道黑色天雷应声而至，瞬间湮灭狐歌周身百米的任何物体。
雷电散去，秦天嘴唇微白，大口喘着粗气，双目死死盯着雷电劈下之处。

狐歌依旧完好无损的蜷缩在原地，甚至连气息都未曾变弱半分！
秦天瞳孔骤缩，惊呼道：“怎么可能！”
他这黑色天雷可是融合了一丝天道之力，已经远远超越了金丹期所能承受的范畴。
别说元婴初期，就算元婴中期稍弱点的强者稍不注意都会有殒命的可能。
content_en:
Qin Tian snorted coldly, his eyes locked on Hu Ge, and his tone was cold with a hint of anger.
"Impossible!"
What kind of person is Hu Ge? If others respect him, he will pay him back, and vice versa.
As soon as he entered the core, he was questioned by Qin Tian like this. Even with Hu Ge's good temper, he couldn't bear it.
Hu Ge narrowed his eyes slightly, raised the corners of his mouth slightly, and said lightly: "Believe it or not, love!"
Qin Tian instantly turned into a purple lightning bolt, and Hu Ge flew backwards before he could react.
Hu Ge coughed and stood up, with a hint of bright red at the corner of his mouth.
"Leilingen!"
The purple lightning shadow slowly condensed, and Qin Tian's figure appeared again.
"Are you a spy sent from the other four continents?"
"It's a golden elixir that hides your cultivation. You just pretended to break through today to spy on us?"
Hu Ge didn't want to explain. He had never been humiliated like this before in his whole life. He must return this humiliation now!
The fox song rotated "Gou", and its body shape changed rapidly, turning into a dung beetle with dark golden patterns on its back.
The gray field quickly spread from under the six legs to the surrounding area, covering a radius of 300 meters.
This is the farthest distance he can extend to maintain the maximum effectiveness of his domain. Before breaking through the golden elixir, he could only cover ten meters, but now he has received a thirty-fold bonus!
"The world of mortals refines the heart!"
Threads of red and filthy aura emitted from the domain and slowly wrapped around Qin Tian.
Qin Tian snorted coldly and said: "It's a small trick!"
The next moment, Qin Tian turned into a ray of light and shadow, dodging all the red filthy energy, rushing straight towards Hu Ge, and flew out again before Hu Ge could react.
But this time he had a mysterious pattern to protect his body. Although he was not facing the enemy from his back, his defense was still strong and he was not injured.
Fox Song rumored: "It's quite fast, but it's a pity that it doesn't have enough attack power!"
Facing Hu Ge's ridicule, Qin Tian's eyes narrowed slightly and his hands quickly formed seals.
The next moment I saw dark clouds in the sky, and there was a faint roar of thunder.
"Insufficient attack power?"
"This is the first time I heard such a comment!"
"Let you see how powerful I am!"
The next moment, a red sky thunder fell from the sky and struck Hu Ge's body instantly.
After suffering hidden losses the first two times, Hu Ge had already curled up in his carapace.
Although the sky thunder was so powerful that it could create a big hole in the ground, it was ineffective against Mao Buyi. His golden mysterious pattern seemed to be naturally capable of restraining the sky thunder.
No powerful thunder can harm it at all.
"Is that okay?" Hu Ge mocked again.
Qin Tian's eyes narrowed, and a trace of anger appeared on his face.
"You asked for this, and you deserve to be beaten to death!"
Qin Tian raised his fingertips to the sky and suddenly fell down. A purple sky thunder struck Hu Ge's body in response.
The golden mysterious pattern faced the sky thunder, and as if it felt provoked, it automatically fell off the carapace, forming a golden light curtain to protect Hu Ge.
Qin Tian was shocked. Although this purple sky thunder was not his strongest attack, it was enough to destroy the average late-stage Golden Core warrior.
This fox song is just the aura of the early stage of Jin Dan, how did he hold it down!
Looking at the protective shield formed by the wonderful golden mysterious patterns, Qin Tian no longer held back.
The next moment, a black thunder struck, instantly annihilating any object within a hundred meters of Hu Ge.
After the thunder and lightning dispersed, Qin Tian's lips turned pale, he was breathing heavily, and his eyes were fixed on the place where the lightning struck.
Hu Ge was still curled up in place intact, and even his breath had not weakened at all!
Qin Tian's pupils shrank suddenly and he exclaimed: "How is that possible!"
His black sky thunder incorporates a trace of the power of heaven, which is far beyond what the golden elixir stage can bear.
Not to mention the early stage of Nascent Soul, even the weaker ones in the middle stage of Nascent Soul may die if they don't pay attention.
